finding: Four NFL sections are published side by side with overlapping requirements, questions, suggestions, strategies and flag lists.
why_it_matters: The owner must know which section is authoritative, and the three packs use different identifiers for the same gates.
requested_action: Adopt one canonical entry point (suggestion S-05) and label the rest as evidence archives.

finding: Eight published standings values for the New York Giants and Washington Commanders no longer match the official standings page.
why_it_matters: The snapshot is correct for its date, but the November 12 game finished after it was taken, so it now reads as stale.
requested_action: Stamp every snapshot with its read time and publish the reconciliation ledger (suggestion S-08).

finding: Eighteen published practice-status claims differ from the official Week 10 report read on 2026-11-13.
evidence: data/nfl_review/value_reconciliation.csv rows IN-006 to IN-049 and DP-051 to DP-073
why_it_matters: The league republishes the report continuously, so a difference is expected rather than an error, but the site does not say so anywhere.
requested_action: Declare a capture timestamp and freeze each capture (suggestion S-09).

finding: The NFL Lab source register cites https://www.nfl.com/official-nfl-rules/, which returns an official NFL 404 page.
why_it_matters: A dead link cannot verify a rule, and rules are cited by several strategy and requirement rows.
requested_action: Re-point the row at the live official 2026 rulebook page (suggestion S-13).

finding: The NFL Lab source register cites https://www.nfl.com/terms/ for the general terms, which resolves to the subscription-terms page.
why_it_matters: The subscription terms scope subscriptions and authentication, not the general permitted-use rule that matters here.
requested_action: Re-point the row at https://www.nfl.com/legal/terms/ (suggestion S-13).

finding: The NFL Lab source register labels the 2017 injury-report policy PDF as verified_direct although it did not return readable text in review.
why_it_matters: The status overstates what was read.
requested_action: Downgrade the row to link-only until the document text is read (suggestion S-13).

finding: The README publishes the live URL https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/Own6/nfl/, which returns 404 because the Pages source is main:/.
evidence: README.md NFL Lab section; GitHub Pages API source = main:/
why_it_matters: A dead link in the first place a reader is sent.
requested_action: Correct the URL to /docs/nfl/ (suggestion S-14).

finding: The CBA page read on 2026-11-13 states the 48-player gameday active roster and the eight-offensive-lineman minimum, but not the 53-player Active/Inactive List size or the 47-player fallback that the Week 10 pack records as verified.
why_it_matters: Two verified rows rest on text that the cited source does not contain.
requested_action: Re-read the CBA Article 32 text or the roster policy page and correct the rows, or downgrade them.

finding: The dataset used by the lines lab comes from a community repository that declares no licence (GitHub API license = null) and the archive root contains no licence file.
why_it_matters: Redistributing an unlicensed dataset inside a public repository is an open legal question.
requested_action: Obtain a licence or replace the dataset (suggestion S-04).

finding: The historical moneyline, spread and total columns in that dataset are community-sourced prices, not official league prices.
why_it_matters: Any ROI computed from them is a community-data estimate, not a verified market figure, and must never be described as one.
requested_action: Keep the label on every published figure and do not publish the dataset as first-party evidence.

finding: The official standings page shows two record columns that its own legend does not define.
why_it_matters: Values copied from those columns cannot be interpreted without guessing, so they are recorded verbatim and flagged.
requested_action: Leave them labelled as unconfirmed or drop them from published tables.

finding: A published Week 10 depth row lists Amani Hooker as a Dallas defensive back, but NFL.com reported that Buffalo acquired him before Week 10.
why_it_matters: The row describes a player who was no longer on that club, so the depth chain is wrong.
requested_action: Correct or remove the row and re-check the other rows against the same roundup.

finding: The three official NFL betting partners agreed to prohibit wagers the league finds objectionable, including bets tied to injuries and bets knowable in advance.
why_it_matters: An injury-driven signal sits close to that line, and the intended use of the project has not been settled.
requested_action: Obtain qualified legal advice and a written answer from the league or a partner before any actionable output (suggestion S-03).

finding: Three gate sets use the same identifiers for different gates: G1-G8 in the NFL Lab, G01-G10 in the NFL Origination pack and G1-G8 in the Week 10 pack.
why_it_matters: A reader cannot compare the packs, and a gate can appear satisfied in one pack and open in another.
requested_action: Adopt one register with a published crosswalk (suggestion S-07).

finding: The repository has no LICENSE file.
why_it_matters: Without a licence the reuse terms of the repository itself are unstated.
requested_action: Add a licence that matches the owner's intent.

finding: No closing line has ever been confirmed for any bet, so the strongest available luck control cannot be computed.
why_it_matters: Without closing-line value the leaderboard cannot distinguish skill from variance, and the reward rule has nothing to rank.
requested_action: Choose and license a price source (suggestion S-12).

finding: The three packs write the same concept three ways: DNP, LP and LIMITED for practice participation, and Out, Doubtful and Questionable for game status.
why_it_matters: The reconciliation script has to guess which published token maps to which official field.
requested_action: Publish one status key and use it in every pack.

finding: Twenty-four of the 32 clubs have no official club depth-chart page captured, so the 2nd, 3rd and 4th string order is unknown for them and every deficiency score is blank.
why_it_matters: The depth-deficiency requirement cannot be met for 24 clubs without that capture.
requested_action: Add a weekly depth-chart capture for all 32 clubs (suggestion S-10).

finding: The published depth chains cite eight club depth-chart pages, but those pages were not re-read in this session, so the depth order itself is carried forward rather than re-verified here.
why_it_matters: The names of the backups behind each starter are the substance of the claim and they were not checked today.
requested_action: Re-read the eight club depth charts and record the read timestamp (suggestion S-10).

finding: Four executive summaries and four sets of flag lists exist, one per pack, with no statement of which is current.
evidence: repository root and the four pack indexes
why_it_matters: The owner asked for one executive summary; there are four.
requested_action: Make the consolidated summary in this pack the index entry point (suggestion S-05).
